# Globalping

Globalping is a global network of probes that allows users to run network tests like ping, traceroute, and DNS resolve from various locations worldwide.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/globalping/.

## Actions

- **Create Measurement**: Create and trigger a network measurement.
- **Get Measurement Results** (read-only): Get measurement results by ID.
- **GlobalPing Health Check** (read-only): Check API health status.
- **List Probes** (read-only): List all currently connected probes.
